text:
priya: Quick sync request — AstraCloud just dropped a final price matrix for reserved vs ephemeral GPUs. Need these numbers fed into the cost model by EOD tomorrow. Specifically: volume discount breakpoints, SLA credit levels for reserved pools, marketplace listing/take rates, and spot preempt behavior. looping in @sam_fin @ellie_pm @mike_ops

sam_fin: Thanks. Can you confirm which Astra SKUs map to our catalog IDs and give per-hour list price + effective % discount at commit sizes (1k / 10k / 50k GPU-hours)? Also need commit windows (1/3/12 mo) and any early-termination penalties.

astra_bot: AstraCloud — price matrix + quick notes below (from vendor ops). SKU mapping + spot/reserved rows: 
```
sku,region,spot_floor_usd,reserved_1m,reserved_3m,reserved_12m,discount_at_10k,discount_at_50k,preempt_profile
astra.a100-80g,us-west,0.35,1.20,1.05,0.85,0.10,0.22,mod-preempt
astra.a100-40g,us-west,0.20,0.80,0.70,0.55,0.08,0.18,high-preempt
astra.v100-32g,us-east,0.12,0.45,0.40,0.33,0.05,0.12,very-high-preempt
```
Notes: spot_floor = expected long-run floor in USD/hr (region-aggregated). Discounts are relative to reserved_1m list price. Preempt_profile = qualitative preempt chance during peak windows. Commit windows are 1/3/12 months. Early termination: pro-rata charge of remaining committed $ unless replaced (negotiable for >50k). Marketplace listing fee: 7% take + 0.5% processing. SLA for reserved pools: 99.9% uptime; SLA credit: 5% of monthly invoice if below threshold, up to 15% in severe outages.

ellie_pm: Nice. For the cost model we need: effective unit cost after marketplace fee + our platform margin layer + expected redemption of SLA credits (assume 0.2% hit initially). Also, how do spot floors behave intra-day? any patterns? 

astra_bot: Spot floors vary by region/time — US-west shows afternoon pressure 12:00-18:00 PST (floors +10-15%). Preempt spikes often at <10min notice for high-preempt SKUs. They provide a historical preempt curve if you want (CSV).

sam_fin: Good detail. Two follow-ups: 1) Billing granularity (per-minute or per-hour?) 2) Do reserved invoices net out spot usage or bill separate lines? We need to model effective blended rate.

astra_bot: Billing is per-minute with 1-minute rounding. Reserved pools billed monthly; spot is on-demand line items. No automatic netting — partners provide monthly usage export so you can blend in cost model.

mike_ops: On infra side — for Dedicated customers we need guaranteed capacity windows. Can Astra honor pinned capacity for reserved pools (we enforce isolation)?

astra_bot: Yes — isolated reserved pools are configurable. Guarantees depend on commit size: >=50k GPU-hrs you can get pinned capacity with an SLA ladder. For smaller commits, they reserve a soft pool with burst guarantees.

priya: Marketing/legal signals — Astra is open to a co-announcement if we align launch to a commit start date and minimum commit (they asked for >=50k GPU-hrs for joint press + logo). Also need to align on public pricing vs marketplace listing (list vs committed pricing disclosure).

ellie_pm: Ok. Action items: 1) @astra_bot / chao to share native CSV + historical preempt curve link (ASAP) 2) @sam_fin to ingest their grid into the cost model and produce delta vs current blended costs (ETA EOD tomorrow) 3) @priya to draft partner comms ask and coordinate legal for marketplace T&Cs.

sam_fin: I'll slot this into the cost model runway. Quick note: assume marketplace fee 7% + our 10% platform margin in the base case, then run sensitivity for 0/5/10% additional discount triggers.

priya: Perfect — once sam posts the model I'll set up a 30-min sync with Astra marketing/legal for announcement windows. Thanks all :thumbsup:
